approval_basis: Repository-owner continuous-iteration and explicit artifact-writing authorization for the v39 dynamic LoopStop whole-grid work Compiler Gate. The exact Gate 3ebe6191591743286c9bf467ced0ce95f2afaac87f96586d9be0d5e9ba595014 matches 64 of 64 Corpus cases across 83 bound Compiler sources, and every case row is identical to the released v38 Gate. No Corpus expectation, manifest case, Schedule, Finding, lowering source, IR primitive, schema, Target contract, QSA branch or backend is changed. Work and top-k cadence now share one generic trip-domain owner that applies add, floor-divide, clamp and tile ceiling per scalar program coordinate, composes one dynamic stop with static loops and other program-axis multiplicity, and reports more than one dynamic stop as unknown without a static-maximum fallback. Profile exposes one per-operation repetition representation. Stopped global-loop Buffer exactness follows whole-Program padded-tile union coverage. Utilization ratios remain available for microbenchmark references, but only device-specification ceilings can create a roofline floor or refutation, and a compulsory-byte upper bound can do neither. Canonical QSA tile128 work is 1,064,768 loop executions, 279,122,542,592 MMA FLOPs and 281,303,187,456 counted FLOPs; the external tile256 frontier geometry is 540,576 executions, 283,417,509,888 MMA FLOPs and 285,631,709,184 counted FLOPs. Both remain lower bounds because cast_query is uncounted. Eighty-four focused tests passed, the expectation no-write check matched, and the frozen QSA Program v2 loaded five nodes with canonical hash fad3c076191d5eefec201eef7f60dc4d3975b94758e5275c511ba450ce6c6669 and unchanged lowering identities. Workload, Program, evaluator, oracle, tolerance, timing, materiality, Target and Executor are unchanged. Historical R10-R27 evidence remains append-only; current Target peak is null, so official complete-Program MFU, BWU and roofline efficiency remain unknown and no GPU, checkpoint or serving result is established. This approval authorizes only this Compiler Revision and no shared-infrastructure change.
